data:text/html,<body><canvas id="SquareMove" width="300" height="250"></canvas><script>const e=document.getElementById("SquareMove"),t=e.getContext("2d");let c=0,i=100;t.fillRect(c,i,20,20),document.addEventListener("keyup",({key:l})=>{" "===l&&(i=70,t.clearRect(0,0,e.width,e.height),t.fillRect(c,i,20,20),setTimeout(function(){i=100,t.clearRect(0,0,e.width,e.height),t.fillRect(c,i,20,20)},300)),"ArrowRight"===l&&(c+=10,t.clearRect(0,0,e.width,e.height),t.fillRect(c,i,20,20)),"ArrowLeft"===l&&(c-=10,t.clearRect(0,0,e.width,e.height),t.fillRect(c,i,20,20))});</script></body>
